_README.note: These are fallback HLS URLs for free/public channels. build_playlist.py now tries iptv-org first; these are only used if iptv-org is missing, blocklisted, or has no stream. Set enabled=false to disable an entry.

ShowTV.tr.name: Show TV
ShowTV.tr.note: Disabled in v3.2: user tested this exact fallback on TCL/TiviMate and another player; it returned 403 or failed playback. Future iptv-org URLs are still eligible.

TLC.tr.name: TLC
TLC.tr.note: Disabled in v3.2: user tested this exact fallback on TCL/TiviMate and another player; it returned 403 or failed playback. Future iptv-org URLs are still eligible.

DMAX.tr.name: DMAX
DMAX.tr.note: Disabled in v3.2: user tested this exact fallback on TCL/TiviMate and another player; it returned 403 or failed playback. Future iptv-org URLs are still eligible.

CNNTurk.tr.name: CNN Türk
CNNTurk.tr.note: Fallback HLS for CNN Türk; iptv-org remains preferred if it becomes available.

Teve2.tr.name: Teve2
Teve2.tr.note: Fallback HLS for free Teve2 live channel.

SportsTV.tr.name: Sports TV
SportsTV.tr.note: Official-domain HLS fallback; may be geo-restricted depending on location.

AkitTV.tr.name: Akit TV
AkitTV.tr.note: Fallback for Akit TV free live stream.

BenguTurk.tr.name: Bengü Türk
BenguTurk.tr.note: Public mirror candidates, not claimed as broadcaster-origin URLs. Used only if health check passes; official-page resolver remains enabled.

APara.tr.name: A Para
APara.tr.note: Public HLS candidate on Turkuvaz/ercdn infrastructure; used only when iptv-org has no stream and only if health check passes.

FlashHaber.tr.name: Flash Haber
FlashHaber.tr.note: Public HLS candidates; second URL came from the user-supplied EXTM3U. Health check decides whether either is usable.

Ekoturk.tr.name: Ekotürk
Ekoturk.tr.note: Public HLS candidate seen in free-TV lists. Health checked before inclusion; official-page resolver remains enabled.

SozcuTV.tr.name: Sözcü TV
SozcuTV.tr.note: Public HLS mirror candidate. Health checked before inclusion; official YouTube/page resolver remains enabled.

KRT.tr.name: KRT
KRT.tr.note: Two public provider HLS candidates. The previous 720p endpoint returned HTTP 500 on GitHub; the simpler master endpoint is tried first.

ANews.tr.name: A News
ANews.tr.note: Public HLS candidate on Turkuvaz/ercdn infrastructure. Health checked before inclusion.

YabanTV.tr.name: Yaban TV
YabanTV.tr.note: Public HLS candidate from longstanding free-TV listings. Health checked before inclusion; official-page resolver remains enabled.

360.tr.note: Alternative public provider/mirror candidates. The exact Turkmedya URLs tested black on the user's TV remain deny-listed. These candidates are included only if the health check accepts them.

LiderHaber.tr.name: Lider Haber
LiderHaber.tr.note: Public HLS candidate found in a current Turkish free-TV list; used only if health check passes.

UlusalKanal.tr.name: Ulusal Kanal
UlusalKanal.tr.note: Legacy/public provider HLS candidate; health checked before inclusion. Official-page resolver remains as fallback.

TGRTBelgesel.tr.name: TGRT Belgesel
TGRTBelgesel.tr.note: Health-checked TGRT Belgesel candidates; first candidate uses Ihlas Digital Assets infrastructure. Official live page remains available separately.
